title: Lint on Write
description: Run linter automatically after any file write or edit to catch issues immediately.

action.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then git diff --name-only -z HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -zE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' | xargs -0 -r npx eslint --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx --max-warnings 0 2>&1 | tail -20; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f setup.py ]; then git diff --name-only -z HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -zE '\.py$' | xargs -0 -r ruff check 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
